gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Synology's own download center for the DS223j and DS223 on DSM 7.3 lists Container Manager (Synology's Docker package) as an armv8 build, so 'DS223j: Docker No' in every ChatGPT table and on our current page is wrong. The real limit is the DS223j's 1 GB of RAM, not missing Docker.
standout_why: Compared against ComputingForGeeks (cited, 2026-10-24), Starry Hope (cited), Terabytewise and nas.kuibu.net (cited). None of them say whether Container Manager or Docker runs on the DS223j or DS223. ComputingForGeeks names 'no Docker' only for the UGREEN DH2300. Starry Hope covers Docker only on the UGREEN models and the DS225+. Terabytewise and kuibu don't mention containers for these models at all. ChatGPT made up the 'Docker: No' cell for the DS223j in at least four answers, and our current page says 'no Docker' (DS223j) and 'Docker unclear' (DS223). Partial overlap: ComputingForGeeks already says that since DSM 7.2.2 Synology hands HEVC, AVC and VC-1 decoding to the playing device, so the codec finding below is not new.
decides: It fixes a column that ChatGPT used to separate the picks. The $209.99 DS223j and $285.99 DS223 can run light containers through Synology's official package, so a buyer who wants Synology software plus one or two small containers (for example a backup or DNS container) doesn't have to go to x86. The pick doesn't change for heavier self-hosting or Plex transcoding: the TerraMaster F2-425 and UGREEN DXP2800 stay ahead because of x86 and Intel Quick Sync, which Starry Hope and ComputingForGeeks both name as the transcoding path Plex and Jellyfin use. The page should change the DS223j cell from 'no Docker' to 'Container Manager available (armv8), 1 GB RAM limits it'.

findings.label: Synology Photos: HEIC and HEVC previews need an add-on
findings.value: 'You will need to install Synology Image Assistant to generate additional previews' for HEIF/HEIC/HIF images and HEVC-encoded MOV/MP4 video
findings.note: This is limitation 6 on the spec page. The mobile app 'supports the Image Assistant feature to generate previews for HEIC photos and HEVC videos'. It affects iPhone photo backup on any Synology picked here (DS223j, DS223). It ties to Synology's DSM 7.2.2 codec discontinuation, which ComputingForGeeks already mentions, so it's only partly new.
